escenas.texto: Asia doesn't do small numbers. This week, ten seconds were enough for one video to pass nineteen million views, and that wasn't even number one. An awards night, a bottle flip, a cat in a printing contest, and the game everyone is playing. But only one video can rule the continent, and it might rule more than one list. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today we count down the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the very end, because number one is something else.

Quick rules before we start. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes straight from the official YouTube API, and the weekly cut is every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Ready? Let's go.

First list: the ten most viewed. Opening the countdown at number ten, from Japan, Saito, with “Bottle Flip”. A fifteen-second Short with over twelve point six million views. And that's just the entry ticket in Asia.
Number nine, from Indonesia, Cici and Mas Bule, with “BTS Bikin Trend Boom Clap”. A forty-eight second Short, and over thirteen point five million views.

Number eight, from India, Neetu Bisht, with a family prank Short of one minute and fifty seconds. Over thirteen point seven million views, and it was posted on the very last day of the week. Imagine where it ends up.

Number seven, from the United Arab Emirates, dami. Dad versus toddler versus the cat: who made the best print? Sixteen seconds, over fifteen point two million views, from a channel of about five thousand, seven hundred subscribers. The underdog of the week.
Number six, from South Korea, K덕톡, with a forty-second Short about CL's MAMA stage. Over fifteen point eight million views, from a channel of about fifty-three thousand subscribers.

Number five, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with part four hundred and five of her series, filmed in West Sumatra. Over twenty-nine minutes long, and over sixteen point three million views. Remember this name. You'll hear it again.
Number four, from South Korea, 가방고리고도리, with a thirty-five second Short. Over seventeen point six million views, from a channel of about one hundred and seventy-two thousand subscribers.
And now, the podium. Bronze medal, from South Korea, RESCENE, with “2026 MAMA”. Ten seconds. Just ten seconds, and over nineteen point eight million views.

Silver medal, from India, Maddock Films, with a one minute and forty-one second promo featuring Shraddha Kapoor, for a film in cinemas on December fourth. Over twenty-seven point two million views. Massive. But not enough.

Drum roll, please. The most viewed video of the week in Asia comes from India. Techno Gamerz, with “MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY”, GTA 6 gameplay part one. Over two hours long, and over thirty-six million views. Thirty-six million. And this is only the first list.
Second list: the conversation. The ten most commented videos. At number ten, لانا و رورو, with a Roblox adventure over twenty-eight minutes long. Over five thousand, four hundred comments.
Number nine, from South Korea, T1, with “Welcome Back Home, Zeus”. Over six thousand, four hundred comments, on the last day of the week.
Number eight, バズチェック, with a one-minute Short. Over six thousand, six hundred comments and over six point four million views, from a channel of about seventeen thousand subscribers.
Number seven, from India, The Roamer Amit, with “Last to Survive SQUID GAME Wins”. Almost an hour long, and over seven thousand, three hundred comments.
Number six, from South Korea, MarvelKorea, with the main trailer of Avengers: Doomsday. Over nine thousand, two hundred comments and over four point four million views.
Number five, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara again. Over eleven thousand comments. Her fans don't just watch. They talk.
Number four, from South Korea, CORTIS, with “We're on a JoyRide (2024)”. Over thirteen thousand, one hundred comments. And this is a name to remember too.
Podium time. Bronze medal, from India, Shivang Mini, with a Roblox Steal an Egg video, over twenty-three minutes long. Over fourteen thousand, four hundred comments.
Silver medal, from Japan, なにわ男子, with their official music video. Over twenty thousand, four hundred comments, from over one point four million views. That's a fan base that shows up.

And here it is. The most commented video of the week in Asia. From India, Techno Gamerz, with “MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY”. Over fifty-four thousand comments. More than double second place. Two lists, two crowns.
And the last list: the love. The ten most liked videos. At number ten, from South Korea, CORTIS, with “We're on a JoyRide (2024)”. Over one hundred and ninety-two thousand likes.
Number nine, from India, Neetu Bisht, with the family prank Short. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes.
Number eight, from India, The Laughter Show, with a comedy clip of two minutes and forty-seven seconds. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes and over eight point five million views.
Number seven, from Japan, Bayashi TV, with “Minions Tortilla Hat”. Thirty-five seconds, and over two hundred and twenty-one thousand likes.

Number six, from India, Whimsy Aangan, with the story of a man who built a refrigerator out of clay for his wife. Over two hundred and twenty-four thousand likes, from a channel of about thirty-one thousand subscribers.
Number five, from India, FactTechz, with “NASA Again Did the IMPOSSIBLE!”. Fifty-two seconds and over two hundred and forty-three thousand likes.
Number four, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara. Third list, third appearance. Over two hundred and sixty-two thousand likes.

The final podium. Bronze medal, from India, resham info, explaining how the Kolkata underwater metro was built. Over two hundred and sixty-seven thousand likes, from a channel of about forty-seven thousand subscribers.
Silver medal, from India, Aman Sharma, with “How Maharashtra Brought a Dead River Back to Life!”. Over three hundred and thirteen thousand likes. A story people loved. But can it beat the giant?

Drum roll, please. The most liked video of the week in Asia: from India, Techno Gamerz, with “MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY”. Over one million likes. One million. Most viewed, most commented and most liked. A clean sweep of all three lists.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
